title: Phase 2 randomized controlled trial of NX-14 for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: efficacy and safety profile
org_or_venue: New England Journal of Medicine, Peer-Reviewed
body: A double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial of 180 patients with moderate IPF received either NX-14 (300 mg BID) or placebo for 24 weeks. NX-14 treatment resulted in a mean forced vital capacity decline of 8% vs 18% in placebo (p=0.012). Adverse events were mild to moderate, primarily GI-related (nausea, diarrhea in 23% vs 12% placebo). No deaths or serious hepatic/renal toxicity was observed. Disease progression was slowed in the NX-14 arm.
